Heracross and Umbreon!

It’s super effective on Togekiss
and Enamorus!

The opposing Shedinja hung
on using its Focus~Sash!
The opposing Umbreon’s HP is full!

It’s not very effective on
Magearna and Togekiss.

The opposing Gastly lost
some of its HP!
